## Earnie 2.6.0-alpha.3

Community **pre-release** of the **2.6** line (follows `2.6.0-alpha.2`). Closes the remaining **2.6** feature letters (**2.6.e** / **2.6.m** / **2.6.n**) plus H0/H11 closure. Pin this tag — **no** `:latest`.

### Highlights

- **2.6.n battery controllability** — `batteries[].control` = `full` | `limits_only` | `read_only`; MILP envelopes; Huawei `plant.ha_ess_force` services for forcible charge/discharge without `set_ess_active_power`
- **2.6.e stronger HA propose** — vendor vocab + token-boundary ranking; all four HouseSim archetypes hit golden maps with zero wrong proposals
- **2.6.m startup / health** — `docker/preflight.sh` (writable dirs, clock vs `BUILD_DATE`, RAM/disk warn); Docker `HEALTHCHECK` + daemon heartbeat (no obsolete add-on `watchdog:`); LoxBerry warns on unhealthy
- **2.6.j H0 / H11** — x86-64-v2 preflight in published images; Gen2 Miniserver still answers plain HTTP (no H11 fix needed)

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.6.0-alpha.3` and `:next` (**no** `:latest`)
- Alpha compose: `docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml` / `loxberry-alpha.yml` / `proxmox-alpha.yml` (pin this tag)

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml up -d
```

Prod `*_productive.yml` with `:latest` stays on the last official (**2.5.3**).

HA add-on: pre-release channel only (`earnie_prerelease`) — official `earnie` is not updated by this tag.
